title: Dray-strap Boots
summary: Something to wear out of the Rings, boots laced from straps the haulers wear through.
author: claude
notes: content: Marrow's Forge will now work a chalkbone bar and a pair of dray straps into boots, to go with the plate, the greaves and the gauntlets.
content: Marrow's Forge has started stocking dray straps, for anyone who would rather buy than pull them off a hauler.

items.name: Dray-strap boots
items.examine: Chalkbone soles, laced with straps pulled off something that carried more than you ever will.
